# Per-Hypothesis Context: H-E1

**Generated by:** Phase 2C Step 1 (JIT from 02b_verification_plan.md)

---

## Hypothesis Information

**ID:** H-E1
**Type:** EXISTENCE
**Statement:** Under GRPO post-training on APPS for DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B, ratio reward (k/n test cases) provides detectably different training signal than binary reward (0/1): per-step gradient norms differ between conditions at training step ≤500, and HumanEval pass@1 at checkpoint 200 shows a directional difference ≥1pp, because ratio reward provides differentiated signal across partially-correct completions within all-failing groups where binary reward assigns identical zero reward.

**Gate:** MUST_WORK — If gradient norms are equivalent AND no directional HumanEval difference exists at step 200, mechanism Step 1 of causal chain is falsified.

**Prerequisites:** None (first in chain)

---

## Experimental Setup (from Phase 2A via Phase 2B)

**Dataset:**
- Name: APPS (Automated Programming Progress Standard)
- Type: standard
- Source: codeparrot/apps (HuggingFace); Hendrycks et al. 2021 (arXiv: 2105.09938)
- Path: auto (HuggingFace download)
- Hypothesis Fit: APPS has native multi-test-case structure (k/n tests per problem) enabling ratio reward computation without dataset modification. 10,000 problems across difficulty levels. Standard training data for RLEF code papers.

**Model:**
- Name: DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B-instruct
- Type: Decoder-only transformer, code-specialized
- Source: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B-instruct (HuggingFace)
- Hypothesis Fit: 7B-class open-weight code LLM with strong HumanEval/MBPP baselines; available weights; representative of current RLEF-capable models.

---

## Variables

- **IV:** Reward signal granularity (binary 0/1 vs. ratio k/n)
- **DV:** Per-step gradient norms (training); HumanEval pass@1 at step 200
- **CV:** Model, algorithm (GRPO), training data (APPS), hyperparameters

---

## Success Criteria

1. Gradient norm difference between binary and ratio conditions is statistically distinguishable (95% bootstrap CI) at ≥1 checkpoint within first 500 steps
2. Directional HumanEval difference ≥1pp at step-200 checkpoint (either direction)

---

## Verification Protocol

Run GRPO post-training for binary and ratio reward conditions on APPS (same problems, same hyperparameters). Monitor per-step gradient norms for both conditions. Evaluate HumanEval pass@1 at step 200. Pre-screen APPS training problems to retain only those with ≥5 non-redundant test cases. Use all 164 HumanEval problems for evaluation. Report gradient norm trajectories and checkpoint evaluation curves.
